event: Nothing else answers readback behavior. Quickly noting "Message is byte granularity" is the only extra.

I submitted a verdict of **verified**: the finding stands. I found no other specification text that says whether bits [2:0] of `MSG_LENGTH_LOWER` read back as written or as zero.

The only relevant text is in `hw/ip/hmac/data/hmac.hjson`. It says "Message is byte granularity. Lower 3 bits [2:0] are ignored." The generated `registers.md` repeats it, and the theory of operation and programmer's guide don't mention those bits. None of them says whether the hardware-updated value always has the bits clear, or whether the padding computation excludes them.

I didn't read the RTL, so the resolution I submitted is only a spec fix. Add text saying whether writes to bits [2:0] are stored and read back, or read as zero, and whether the hardware length and padding computation ignore them.
